import sys

sys.path.insert(0, sys.argv[1])

import invoice

items = [
    {"unit_price": 9.99, "quantity": 3},
    {"unit_price": 120.0, "quantity": 1, "cancelled": True},
    {"unit_price": 0.35, "quantity": 12},
]
print(invoice.total_net(items), invoice.total_gross(items))
print(invoice.total_net([]), invoice.total_gross([]))
assert invoice.total_net(items) == 34.17
assert invoice.total_gross(items) == 41.0
print("ok")
